title: docgen.config.json
description: Configuration for a DocGen documentation site.

tagline.description: One line shown on the home page hero.

description.description: Home page banner text and meta description. Default: the GitHub org/user description (single owner) or repo description (single repo), else the tagline.

url.description: "auto" (GitHub Pages / CI) or an origin like https://docs.example.com

footer.description: Extra footer line (e.g. funding acknowledgement), shown centered under the copyright.

name.description: Who the hub is for (lab, org, project). Default: the GitHub display name of the single owner, else the single repo title, else site.title.

heroTitle.description: Home page heading. Default: "Welcome to the Official Documentation Hub for <name>".

copyrightHolder.description: Footer copyright holder. Default: name. The year is the build year.

owners.description: GitHub users and/or organizations (name or https://github.com/<name>). Every public repo of each is documented, minus forks/archived/excluded. Your personal account and orgs can be mixed: ["me", "my-org"].

repos.description: Specific repos to document (owner/name or URL). Always included, even if fork/archived or outside include. Use alone to document only a few repos.

include.description: Only keep these repos from owners (glob; "tool-*" matches the name, "acme/tool-*" the full name). Empty = all. Does not affect repos.

exclude.description: Skip these repos from owners (glob on name or owner/name).

includeEmpty.description: Also list repos without a Markdown README.

includeDefaultBranch.description: Add a "next" folder built from the default branch.

repo.description: Legacy single repo; same as repos: [value].

org.description: Legacy single org; same as owners: [value].

source.description: What to document: any mix of whole accounts (owners) and hand-picked repos (repos). At least one entry is required.

logo.description: https:// URL or a file inside branding/. Empty = neutral default.

favicon.description: https:// URL or a file inside branding/. Empty = logo, then default.

socialCard.description: 1200x630 PNG/JPG for link previews. Empty = default.

banner.description: Optional home page banner background image: file in branding/ or https:// URL (wide image, ~1600x500).

diataxis.description: auto = template headings if present, else classify sections by heading; strict = template headings only; off = one page per README.

stopAtHeadings.description: Drop everything from the first heading with one of these names (e.g. Contributing).

tagsFromTopics.description: Use GitHub repo topics as tags.

tagsFromReadme.description: Use a "**Tags:** a, b" line in the README as tags.

lastUpdated.description: Show "Last updated" on every page from the last commit that touched the README (1 extra API call per repo version).

openapi.description: OpenAPI/Swagger specs found in repos are published under "APIs" in the navbar.

enabled.description: Detect openapi.* / swagger.* (.json/.yaml) files (1 API call per repo version).

explorer.description: Add an interactive explorer page (Redoc, pinned + integrity-checked, loaded from jsDelivr in the browser).
